definitions.explanation: A question word asking to identify one item from a group of three or more. Used when choices are not directly attached to nouns.

examples.japanese: あなたのかばんはどれですか？
どれが{一番|いちばん}{好|す}きですか？
examples.english: Which one do you like the best?

examples.japanese: どれでもいいですから、{好|す}きなのを{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Any one is fine, so please choose the one you like.
examples.notes: どれでも = any one (of them)

examples.japanese: たくさんのスマホがありますが、この{中|なか}でどれが{一番|いちばん}{人気|にんき}がありますか？
examples.english: There are many smartphones, but which one of these is the most popular?

examples.japanese: ケーキがたくさんあるけど、どれを{食|た}べたいか{決|き}められないので、{友達|ともだち}に{選|えら}んでもらいました。
examples.english: There are many cakes, but I couldn't decide which one I wanted to eat, so I had my friend choose for me.

notes:
どれ is a question word for selecting one item from three or more options.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
- これ: this one (near speaker)
- それ: that one (near listener)
- あれ: that one over there (far from both)
- どれ: which one? (question)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれが{一番|いちばん}〜: which one is the most ~?
- どれでも: any one (of them)
- どれでもいい: any one is fine

NOTE:
For two items, use どちら instead. どれ implies three or more choices.

RELATED:
- どの + noun: which ~ (attributive form)
